# OCCUPIED! project evidence

Four original PNG images supplied by Siyi Yu: the blue-door character photograph,
interaction / state map, electronics diagram, and prototype-testing montage.
Source images are retained without retouching. The cover uses `blue-door.png`.

The displayed interaction and electronics diagrams now use the user-requested
`Frame 4.png` and `Frame 5.png` exports, copied unchanged as
`interaction-frame-4.png` and `electronics-frame-5.png`. Both are 842×595.
Their desktop display width is limited to 842 CSS pixels; mobile reading keeps
the existing horizontal pan. The earlier diagram files are retained as sources.

Year confirmed by Siyi Yu as 2025. Narrative order follows the supplied layout
brief: first impression, interactive storytelling / user journey, and concept to
reality. The brief is used as content guidance, not inserted as a screenshot.

Technical details are taken from the supplied diagrams: Bela and C++ control,
five servo motors, a piezo knock sensor, paper microswitch, magnetic reed switch,
push button, COB LED, and speaker. No external client or brand is asserted.

The closing film is a complete 57.52-second web rendition of the supplied
`GMMB5145.MP4`: 1920×1080 H.264 / AAC with its original audio, and MP4 metadata
at the front for streaming. It is an inline native player, muted initially.
Only this film opts into scroll playback; leaving view or hiding the page
pauses it. An intentional pause is respected while it remains in view.
The full source file remains outside the repository; encoding details and the
web-file checksum are recorded in `docs/occupied-video.json`.
